name: Pinterest Hover Button
description: Adds Pinterest 'Pin It' hover buttons to images on the site by attaching Pinterest's pinit.js, with configurable button size/shape/colour, per-content-type targeting and CSS-selector exclusions.
project_description:
A simple module to allow the Pinterest On Hover Pin It button to be added for images on the site.

 Features 
 
 You can also exclude images with jQuery selectors. 
 Includes special support for hover buttons on responsive images. 
 The hover button can be enabled per content type. 
 Size, color & shape can be configured. 
 
 Helpful Links 
 
 Pinterest documentation about the On Hover Pin It button 
 Pinterest button style options - pick Image Hover for button type (these can be configured inside Drupal on the module's admin page) 
 pinit.js in readable form for debugging
